definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to a noun to name a period of time with a particular character (a season, a stage of life or growth), or with a number to name one of a series of terms, phases, or intakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{反抗期|はんこうき}→反抗期：15877_hankouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: My son has entered his rebellious phase.

examples.japanese: ⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧2{期|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The second phase of construction starts next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成長期|せいちょうき}→成長期：21342_seichouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧な⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Children in their growth period need plenty of sleep and nutrition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{繁忙期|はんぼうき}→繁忙期：08366_hanbouki⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: The end of the year is our busy season, so it's hard to take time off.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{思春期|ししゅんき}→思春期：12667_shishunki⟧: puberty; adolescence
- ⟦{反抗期|はんこうき}→反抗期：15877_hankouki⟧: rebellious phase
- ⟦{成長期|せいちょうき}→成長期：21342_seichouki⟧: growth period
- ⟦{繁忙期|はんぼうき}→繁忙期：08366_hanbouki⟧: busy season
- ⟦{上半期|かみはんき}→上半期：20412_kamihanki⟧: first half of the (fiscal) year
- ⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧〜{期|き}: the Nth term or phase; 〜{期生|きせい}: the Nth intake of students or members

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: era; a longer historical span
- 〜⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: time, season; a free-standing noun, not a suffix
